text:
olivia: Starting v2 rollout now to eu-west shards. Gate = client-version header check; canary at 10% for 30m. Release notes: https://redwood/release/rls-2026-03-20
jason: Confirming deploy window open until 14:30 UTC. Will watch metrics (latency, 5xx, resp drift).
carla: heads up — mobile SDK 1.2.0 doesn't set X-Client-Api-Version header. Mobile teams still on 1.1.x for some users. We should expect unmapped traffic hitting v2.
sam: we have a fallback route that sends unversioned traffic to v1. Should we enable header_gate_strict=true? That would reject unversioned clients.
nina: production told us: can't break older clients mid-day. Suggest pin unversioned to v1 and run canary for header=true only.
deploy-bot: [deploy] v2-gateway canary => 10% traffic (10 instances). commit abc123. Started 2026-03-20T13:45:34Z
jason: metric check: initial 5xx baseline 0.08%. We'll set rollback trigger = 0.5% sustained for 5m or latency P95 > 600ms.
olivia: Agreed. Also need release notes callout for SDK upgrade + migration header example.
carla: I'll draft SDK patch and push 1.2.1 with header set. ETA 2h.
sam: Ops — if we need to pin, use this curl to update routing:

curl -X POST https://ops-api.redwood.internal/routes/pin -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"route":"/v2","pin_to":"v1","selector":"unversioned"}'

sam: (replace $TOKEN in ops-run)
olivia: jason — any early error spike?
jason: @olivia 5xx at 13:53 up to 0.62% across canary. Error traces point to client schema mismatch: missing header -> server picks v2 default -> validation fails.
olivia: ok trigger hit. Do pin and pause rollout. @sam can you run the curl?
sam: running now.
deploy-bot: [deploy] route pin request accepted. route /v2 unmapped -> v1 for selector unversioned. run id pin-789
sam: pinned. Canary rollout paused and traffic rebalanced.
carla: pushing SDK 1.2.1 now with header. Will open PR and publish patch notes.
nina: I'll update release notes and send in #announcements after patch published. Also flag customers if they have older embedded clients.
jason: metrics falling back to baseline. 5xx back to 0.09% at 13:59.
olivia: Good. Action items: 1) Carla publish SDK 1.2.1 + migration guide. 2) Product to update release notes and alert customers. 3) Ops to keep pin until 1.2.1 adoption > 80% (monitoring: header present pct).
carla: noted. I'll post PR and estimate adoption telemetry in 48h.
olivia: thanks everyone. We'll resume canary after adoption threshold or schedule a night window.
nina: posting postmortem-ish note in eng-releases channel with timeline. :memo: 
deploy-bot: [deploy] pause accepted for rollout abc123. Canary paused at 10%.
olivia: closing thread — will re-open when ready.
